description:
Ring a number and have the agent speak one phrase, then hang up. A probe, not a conversation: it answers "is the trunk configured and does this agent sound right" in seconds. For a real conversation use place_call. THIS RINGS A REAL PHONE AND SPENDS REAL CREDIT — the meter runs on a test call exactly as on any other, so confirm the number with the user first. Human transfer is not offered during a test call, so this cannot check that a transfer destination answers. Needs calls:write.

Requires scope `calls:write`.

from_number_id.description: Defaults to the agent's own outbound number. See list_phone_numbers.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for safe retries. Generated automatically when omitted. Reuse the SAME value when retrying the SAME logical request; never reuse it for a different one.

phrase.description: What to say. Defaults to the agent's opening message, which is usually what you want to hear.

to.description: Destination in E.164 form, e.g. "+14155551234". A real phone will ring.

name: test_call_agent
title: Place a test call
